# Strum Media

> Melbourne-based video production, photography and drone content studio. Strum Media creates cinematic video, professional photography, aerial/drone footage, social media content, podcasting and ongoing content for construction, property, corporate and consumer brands — based in Melbourne and servicing all of Australia.

## About
- [About Strum Media](https://www.strummedia.com.au/about): Who we are, our mission, our team and the clients we work with.
- [Contact](https://www.strummedia.com.au/contact): Enquiries — phone +61 3 7056 9217, email admin@strummarketing.com.au.

## Services
- [Videography](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-videography): Cinematic video production for projects, brands and campaigns.
- [Photography](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-photography): Professional stills for sites, products, teams and listings.
- [Aerial & Drone](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-aerial-drone): Aerial video and photography for sites, property and infrastructure.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-social-media-management): Ongoing social content, strategy and management.
- [Podcasting](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-podcasting): Podcast filming, recording and production.
- [Content Creation](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-content-creation): Reels, short-form and ongoing content.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.strummedia.com.au/service-digital-marketing): Facebook and Meta ads management and SEO optimisation.
- [All services](https://www.strummedia.com.au/services): Overview of everything Strum Media offers.

## Industries
- [Construction](https://www.strummedia.com.au/construction-media): Construction video production in Melbourne: progress films, project showcase films, tender and capability videos, recruitment content, social cuts, drone footage and site photography for builders, developers, contractors and trades, from early works to handover.
- [Property Developments](https://www.strummedia.com.au/developments-media): Video, photography and aerial for residential and commercial developments.
- [Residential Developments](https://www.strummedia.com.au/residential-development-media): Content for apartments, townhouses and house-and-land developers.
- [Real Estate](https://www.strummedia.com.au/real-estate-media): Property tours, listing photography and aerial for agents and agencies.
- [Infrastructure](https://www.strummedia.com.au/infrastructure-media): Aerial, progress documentation and photography for major civil projects.
- [Government](https://www.strummedia.com.au/government-media): Public-sector project documentation and communications content.
- [Corporate](https://www.strummedia.com.au/corporate-media): Brand, culture and campaign content for corporate teams.
- [Demolition](https://www.strummedia.com.au/demolition-media): Documentation and aerial for demolition and site works.
- [Medical & Healthcare](https://www.strummedia.com.au/medical-media): Medical and healthcare video production in Melbourne: practice films, practitioner introductions, patient education videos, captioned social reels and clinic photography.
- [Automotive](https://www.strummedia.com.au/automotive-media): Photography, video, reels and content for dealerships and automotive brands.
- [Hospitality](https://www.strummedia.com.au/hospitality-media): Content for venues, restaurants and hospitality brands.
- [Retail & Consumer](https://www.strummedia.com.au/retail-media): Content for retail and consumer brands.
- [Personal Brand](https://www.strummedia.com.au/personal-brand-media): Content and media for personal and founder brands.

## Blog
- [Blog](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog): Articles on construction videography, site progress documentation, cinematic property film and Meta ads.
- [What Goes Into Construction Videography, and What Affects the Cost](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-construction-videography): What construction videography involves, the six types of construction video (project films, progress, tender and capability, recruitment, social and aerial), filming on live sites, the factors that affect construction videography cost, and what to look for in a construction videographer. Includes West Gate Bridge, Clayton Business Park, Kia Kilmore and Hume Anglican Grammar examples.
- [Video for Government and Council Projects: A Practical Guide](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-government-video-production): How Melbourne councils, state agencies and public sector contractors use video, the common types of government video, what is different about public sector work (accessibility, messaging, sign-off, filming in public, live sites), getting more from one shoot, and choosing a crew. Includes the West Gate Bridge example.
- [Drone Video for Construction: What It's Good For and How It Works](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-construction-drone-video): What Melbourne builders use drone footage for (progress records, tenders, client updates, marketing, site planning), the aerial shots worth getting (cinematic, reveals, top-down, repeat-position progress, FPV, stills), how a construction drone shoot works, the CASA drone rules, planning flights across a build, and drone video vs drone survey. Includes West Gate Bridge, Hume Anglican Grammar and Holmes Plumbing Prahran examples.
- [Construction Recruitment Videos: Attracting Workers in a Skills Shortage](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-construction-recruitment-video): How builders and contractors use recruitment video to attract tradespeople during the construction skills shortage, what workers want to see, the types of recruitment video, what makes them work and where to use them, with Holmes Plumbing, MERCS Projects and West Gate Bridge examples.
- [Facebook Ads Management in Melbourne: What You Should Actually Get](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-facebook-ads-management-melbourne): What Facebook and Instagram ads management should include (strategy, setup, creative, testing, reporting, lead follow-up), what to expect in the first month, questions to ask before hiring an agency, red flags, and who it suits. Strum Media offers Facebook ads management for Melbourne construction, trades and property businesses.
- [Using Video to Win Construction Tenders and EOIs](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-construction-tender-video): How builders use construction tender video, capability videos and company profile videos in tenders, EOIs and prequalification, what evaluators score, how to add video to a capability statement, with Clayton Business Park and West Gate Bridge examples.
- [Your Best Work Is Behind the Walls: Content for Plumbers and Trades](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-video-content-for-plumbers-and-trades): Why trade businesses get lost behind the builder on most projects, what plumbers should film (scale, team, work and partners), where the content gets used and why rough-in is the time to capture it. Includes the Holmes Plumbing Prahran example.
- [Meta Ads in 2026: What Businesses Should Actually Measure](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-meta-ads-for-business-melbourne): How to measure Meta Ads beyond cost per lead, using a five-level ladder from delivery to commercial outcome.
- [Why Every Builder Should Be Filming Site Progress](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-construction-site-progress-video): Why construction progress video matters for tenders, client updates, site records, recruitment and social media, which stages to film and what each is used for, what to capture on every visit, and real examples from MERCS Projects Elizabeth, Clayton Business Park, Scotch Hill Gardens, Holmes Plumbing Prahran, Kia Kilmore and Hume Anglican Grammar.
- [5 Types of Video Content Every Construction Company Needs](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-video-content-construction-companies): Project films, progress content, short-form social, recruitment video and capability films — what each is used for and how one shoot feeds all of them.
- [Why Cinematic Property Videos Win Buyers, Agents and Builders](https://www.strummedia.com.au/blog-cinematic-property-video-melbourne): How a cinematic property film sells the home for the agent, markets the builder, and becomes a keepsake the family shares — turning one shoot into ongoing referrals.
